answer_summary: Via 2 searches: a PR professional in crypto and AI, fractional PR manager for Web3/AI founders, 6 years, outlets incl Forbes/CoinDesk; says she built CoinMarketCap regional comms and leads PR at Myosin DAO. Cites her site, Wiza, ZoomInfo.

Says background looks strong on paper (Head of PR Myosin DAO, ex CoinMarketCap APAC PR, NEAR/Chainbase/Talent Protocol per Icebreaker) but found no independent reviews, Clutch listing or testimonials; claims are self-reported; advises checking references first.

Cites her site: fractional PR about $5K to $12K per month (agencies $15K to $45K); analyst relations sprint $12K to $28K for 8 to 12 weeks; includes senior operator, story architecture, founder profiling, APAC plus global coverage, Tier-1 outreach, AEO. Advises confirming scope.

Names NEAR, Chainbase, Talent Protocol (via Myosin DAO) and profile-listed web3auth.io, beyondnetwork.xyz, cloudless.dev, bloom360.io, momentum6.com, coinmarketcap.com, reef.io from Icebreaker. No confirmed AI client found; her site not cited.

Accurately describes it as her personal portfolio site: fractional PR for crypto/AI, media placements, ghostwriting, crisis comms, blog playbooks, testimonials page (19 LinkedIn recs). Flags price conflict: page says $3k-7k/month, search description $5k-10k.

No single winner: Shilika is an individual (senior, hands-on, Asia focus; check if she takes direct clients), Coinbound for influencer/full-funnel at scale, EAK for media and events. Suggests Shilika if early stage and budget tight. Her site not cited.

Found no articles by or quotes from her in CoinDesk, Cointelegraph or Forbes; those names are in her own bio as client coverage. Site cites MANTRA Chain $11M raise coverage (CoinDesk, Decrypt, CryptoPotato, Cointelegraph). Self-reported; verify.

Yes to all four: read her site; APAC coverage incl Korea, Japan, Singapore, UAE with dedicated region pages and local outlets/events per market; MANTRA Chain Middle East angle. Notes site price $3k to 7k/month vs higher ranges elsewhere.
